message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libucl && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/fuzzers/ucl_add_string_fuzzer.c')
print(p.read_text())
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzzers/ucl_add_string_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":6,"var":"data,size","code":"ucl_parser_add_string(parser, (char *)data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are passed directly into the parser as the configuration string."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/ucl_parser.c","function":"ucl_parser_add_string_priority","line":3054,"var":"data,size","code":"ucl_parser_add_string_priority(parser, data, size, priority);","note":"The parser consumes the raw input and builds UCL objects from it, preserving attacker-controlled keys and nested objects."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/ucl_parser.c","function":"ucl_parser_process_object_element","line":1178,"var":"nobj","code":"tobj = __DECONST (ucl_object_t *, ucl_hash_search_obj (cur->value.ov, nobj));","note":"When an object element is inserted, the parser looks up an existing entry using the attacker-controlled key stored in nobj."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/ucl_hash.c","function":"ucl_hash_search","line":446,"var":"search.key/search.keylen","code":"search.key = key; search.keylen = keylen;","note":"The lookup constructs a temporary search object from the supplied key pointer and length, so the hash code will read those bytes during hashing and comparison."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/ucl_hash.c","function":"ucl_hash_func","line":103,"var":"o->key/o->keylen","code":"return mum_hash (o->key, o->keylen, ucl_hash_seed ());","note":"The hash function reads the key bytes to compute the bucket index; if the key metadata is inconsistent, this becomes an out-of-bounds read in the hashing routine."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/ucl_util.c","function":"ucl_object_insert_key_common","line":2421,"var":"found","code":"found = __DECONST (ucl_object_t *, ucl_hash_search_obj (top->value.ov, elt));","note":"Duplicate object keys trigger a hash-table search during insertion, which reaches the buggy hash path and can crash under ASAN with a heap-buffer-overflow read."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.txt /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 1.
